test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Kiran had a short ________ as a writer.
solution:
The correct answer is "**career**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

 

 
• **In the given sentence, the blank will explain the job that the subject had for a short period.**
 
• Now, let us understand the meaning of the given words:
 
 
• "Caress" means to touch or stroke gently. 
 
 
• Example: She caressed the soft fur of the kitten.
 
 
 
• **"Career" means a person's profession or occupation**.
 
 
• Example: I want a career as a banker.
 
 
 
• "Carer" means a person who takes care of someone who is ill or disabled.
 
 
• Example: She works as a carer for elderly patients.
 
 
 
• ​"Carrier" means a person or thing that carries or transports something. 
 
 
• Example: The truck is a carrier of goods.
 
 
 
 
 
• The sentence implies that Kiran worked as a writer for a brief period of time.
 
• "Career" is the only option that fits grammatically and contextually in the sentence.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.
